summary.en-US: Password manager for the wasc self-hosted vault at passwords.wasc.me. A rebranded build of the Bitwarden browser extension.

version.approval_notes: Rebranded build of the open-source Bitwarden browser extension (GPL-3.0), preconfigured for a private self-hosted server. Build: npm ci at the repository root, then npm run dist:firefox in apps/browser (Node version from .nvmrc). Output: apps/browser/build. The fork diff against upstream is in the wasc/ directory and commits on the wasc branch.
